basic_profile.bio: A tech enthusiast and gadget aficionado, I hail from the bustling city of San Francisco. I'm a software developer by profession, currently working in a mid-sized tech firm. My interests revolve around smart home technology, virtual reality, and audio equipment. I'm an expat originally from Germany, navigating the quirks of American life. I usually browse Reddit during late evenings to unwind after work. While I'm in a long-term relationship, my partner and I enjoy our independent hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Computer Science from a university in Munich. My career path led me to specialize in IoT and home automation systems, which sparked my interest in smart home technologies. I often stay updated through online courses and tech forums.
